failure_scope: Only new backCancelsOnlyTheAreaSelectorAndRestoresSourceFocus stopped at assertTrue(device.pressBack()) line222 before checking overlay dismissal or source focus. No failure-time screenshot was collected at that direct assertion.

test_api_source.meaning: pressBack injects DOWN/UP and returns whether TYPE_WINDOW_CONTENT_CHANGED was observed within a timeout. The boolean is not a direct assertion of selector dismissal.
test_api_source.provenance_limit: Official source preceding UiAutomator2.3 release, inspected directly; not a byte-for-byte comparison with the installed sources JAR.
